findings.observed: Broad soft dark under-tier bands exaggerate the impression of separated lids compared with source blue occlusion seams. Basic tier proportions are already close.
findings.repair: Use closer visual overlap and narrower source-like blue seams; keep this adjustment modest and preserve full tree height.
